result.title: Comparing GenAI to Machine Learning and Manual Review for eDiscovery
result.summary: Keeling et al. [Keeling2026Generative] report on a case study recently conducted by Redgrave LLP in which they assert that Relativity's Generative AI Review tool (aiR) achieved 88% recall while Relativity Assisted Learning (RAL), its machine-learning tool, achieved 64% recall. These results are not comparable because the methods employed have different objectives, because of inter-assessor disagreement, and because they represent different recall-precision and cost-benefit trade-offs. Our analysis of the Redgrave data indicates that, when these differences are taken into account, aiR and manual review are comparable. Furthermore, established machine-learning models employing Continuous Active Learning (CAL) show state-of-the-art effectiveness, and superior efficiency, when trained only on a sample of 2,000 first-pass-reviewer responsiveness determinations.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对 Redgrave 的 eDiscovery 案例研究，论证其 GenAI 审阅工具与机器学习工具（RAL）的召回率数字不可直接比较，并指出采用连续主动学习（CAL）的模型仅用 2000 条样本即达到更优效果与效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是法律取证文档审阅中的召回归因与成本收益比较，不涉及 VLM 内部状态、视觉证据或 latent 推理，除泛泛的评估指标讨论外没有可供核查的方法线索。
